sections.headline: The Rise of AKG
sections.body_copy: Founded in the Spring of 2017, the Aaron Kirman Group (AKG) was created with a mission to foster collaboration, resource sharing, growth, and support among like-minded professionals. That vision evolved significantly in the Fall of 2022, when AKG transitioned into a brokerage and formed a landmark partnership with Christie's International Real Estate, resulting in the launch of AKG | Christie's International Real Estate. What began as a team of 7 agents and staff has since grown into a brokerage of more than 300 people as of 2026, reflecting its rapid expansion and continued evolution within the luxury real estate industry.
sections.founders_copy: The brokerage was founded by Aaron Kirman, President and CEO of Christie’s International Real Estate | Southern California, headquartered in Beverly Hills. Aaron has consistently been recognized as one of the top agents in the world and was named the #1 Agent in Los Angeles. Representing landmark estates such as 'The One', the Danny Thomas Estate, and the Edie Goetz Estate, Aaron has amassed over $24 Billion in individual luxury sales.

sections.headline: Unmatched Sales, Unparalleled Network
sections.body_copy: With a remarkable track record of notable sales including John Lautner's Garcia House, Scott Johnson's The Wall House, and Richard Landry's Brentwood Estate, the brokerage has amassed $19 billion+ in properties sold. These accomplished agents are revolutionizing one of the most competitive industries in the world.
